recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No further FHIR core source work is needed for FHIR-6129 unless a future work group reopens retired ProcedureRequest history or asks for broader editorial cleanup.
issue_request: FHIR-6129 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU1 Procedure. The discussion clarified that the request was an element rename rather than a datatype change, and the PC work group motion changed Procedure.name to Procedure.code with clarifying description and applied the same rename to ProcedureRequest.
initial_application: Commit 77c0aa01f08d8517bcba177c89b296095491221d explicitly applied #6129 and #7123 by renaming type to code for Procedure and ProcedureRequest and updating examples, profiles, and the procedure-code value set.
additional_context: FHIR-7123 is the same change family and first resolved the Procedure category-versus-type confusion as Procedure.name before FHIR-6129 harmonized the name to Procedure.code. In the current build, Procedure and ServiceRequest are active resources, ProcedureRequest is retired and merged into ServiceRequest, and an existing FHIR-7123 reconciliation commit already corrected the remaining active Procedure notes example from name=amputation to code=amputation.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Procedure.code is the active Procedure element, ServiceRequest.code is the active successor request element, and retired ProcedureRequest source is outside the current build.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published/Persuasive Procedure category/type issue implemented together with FHIR-6129 in commit 77c0aa01f08d8517bcba177c89b296095491221d; it already has a separate FHIR-7123 reconciliation commit.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive PC issue requiring Procedure.name/type to be renamed to Procedure.code and the same change made to ProcedureRequest.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes final work group intent and the current source expectation: code, not name or type, should identify the procedure.

evidence_items.summary: Historical commit explicitly says #6129 and #7123 renamed type to code for Procedure and ProcedureRequest and updated examples and profiles.
evidence_items.learned: The requested rename was historically applied rather than missing from current source.

evidence_items.summary: Procedure and ServiceRequest are active current resources; ProcedureRequest is listed only as a retired resource merged into ServiceRequest.
evidence_items.learned: Build-scope verification belongs on Procedure and ServiceRequest, while retired ProcedureRequest source is not a current-spec edit target.

evidence_items.summary: Procedure.code is the active element with short text 'Identification of the procedure' and type retained only as an alias.
evidence_items.learned: The active Procedure definition satisfies the FHIR-6129 rename and preserves implementer understanding.

evidence_items.summary: ServiceRequest.code identifies the requested service or procedure and binds to the procedure-code value set.

evidence_items.learned: The only same-family active-source drift already has a separate issue commit, so FHIR-6129 should not duplicate that source edit.
